node.title: L1 joint-Johnson source-scale gate
node.statement: The nonpositive joint-Johnson region implies the variance constraint a(N-a)/N+u(b-u)/b>=ell when b>0; zero background gives the analogous core-only constraint. Hence every bounded-polarity live cell has N+b>=4ell and N>=3ell+1. In an official rate-1/r source, (r-1)k+1=Mell+b then forces M>=3(r-1), so all smaller source scales are polynomial per chart. The first live counts are M>=3,9,21,45 at rates 1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16. The arithmetic family ell=2r,b=2r-1,k=6r+2,M=3(r-1) attains N+b=4ell, so the source-scale constant is arithmetically sharp.
